data.name: Hikmah
data.gender_notes: Hikmah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The acquisition of knowledge, skills, and understanding through experience or education. The name Hikmah carries the meaning “Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Hikmah usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Hikmah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hikmah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: حكمة
in_arabic.meaning: الحكمة هي الفهم العميق والقدرة على اتخاذ القرارات الصائبة
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحكمة هي اسم مشتق من الحكمة، وهي الفهم العميق والقدرة على اتخاذ القرارات الصائبة. وردت الحكمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: "الحكمة عند الله". تعتبر الحكمة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية وصفات إيجابية، وتدل على الحكمة والفطنة

in_urdu.name: حکمت
in_urdu.meaning: حکمت کا مطلب ہے گہری سمجھ اور صحیح فیصلے کرنے کی صلاحیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حکمت ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے گہری سمجھ اور صحیح فیصلے کرنے کی صلاحیت۔ یہ نام حکمت کے عربی جڑ سے ماخوذ ہے، جو قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر کیا گیا ہے۔ حِکمت کو ایک روحانی نام کے طور پر سمجھا جاتا ہے جو حکمت اور فطری صلاحیتوں کی علامت ہے

in_hindi.name: हिक्मत
in_hindi.meaning: हिक्मत का अर्थ है गहरी समझ और सही निर्णय लेने की क्षमता
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिक्मत एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है गहरी समझ और सही निर्णय लेने की क्षमता। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण माने जाते हैं और अक्सर आध्यात्मिक और बुद्धिमत्तापूर्ण गुणों से जुड़े होते हैं

in_pashto.name: حکمت
in_pashto.meaning: حکمت د ګډې پوهې او د سمې پرېکړې کولو وړتیا
in_pashto.long_meaning: حکمت د عربي نوم دی چې د ګډې پوهې او د سمې پرېکړې کولو وړتیا مانا لري. دا نوم د حکمت د عربي ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی او د افغانستان او پاکستان د پښتنو ټولنو کې دود دی

in_english.name: Hikmah
in_english.meaning: Wisdom, deep understanding, and ability to make sound decisions
in_english.long_meaning: Hikmah is an Arabic name derived from the root 'H-K-M', which signifies wisdom, deep understanding, and the ability to make sound decisions. Mentioned in the Quran, Hikmah is associated with spiritual and intellectual qualities. It symbolizes prudence, intelligence, and good judgment, making it a revered name in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The Islamic name "Hikmah" holds significant cultural importance as it is rooted in the belief that knowledge is a fundamental aspect of personal growth and development. In Arabic, the word 'hikmah' refers to wisdom or understanding. This name is a reminder of the importance of continuous learning and the acquisition of skills and knowledge throughout one's life. In many Muslim communities, education and knowledge are highly valued, and the pursuit of hikmah is seen as not only a personal goal but also a communal responsibility.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Hikmah" represents the wisdom and guidance bestowed upon us by Allah. The Quran and Hadith are filled with reminders of the importance of seeking knowledge and understanding, as it is through a deep understanding of the divine teachings that we can draw closer to Allah. The name also reflects the belief in the interconnectedness of all things and the understanding that wisdom applies not only to academic pursuits but to all areas of life, including our relationships, our actions, and our connection to the Divine. Thus, the name "Hikmah" serves as a reminder of the value of seeking knowledge, both in the practical world and in the spiritual realm, as we strive to live our lives in accordance with Allah's will.
